Invite for Novelis – Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call 
 
 
Dear All, 
We are pleased to invite you to the Earnings Conference Call for Novelis Inc. (wholly owned subsidiary of 
Hindalco) to be held on Thursday, 5th November 2026, following the announcement of financial results 
for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call will be initiated with a brief management 
discussion and presentation on the Q2-FY27 earnings and performance, followed by an interactive 
question and answer session.  
 
Pre-Registration and live webcast link of the conference call is as below: 
Date:                                               
Thursday, 5th November 2026 
Time:                                             
17:30 HRS IST (India time) 
 
 
Pre-registration Link*: 
Click Here 
Live webcast Link  
(to view slides and listen only)  
Click Here  
*Upon registering you will receive the dial-in info and a unique PIN to join the call as well as an email 
confirmation with the details.  
Presentation materials will be available online at Novelis Inc. 
 
For further information, please contact: 
 
 
 
 
 
ATLANTA – October 29, 2026 – Novelis Inc 
 
About Novelis (wholly owned subsidiary of Hindalco) 
Novelis Inc. is driven by its purpose of shaping a sustainable world together. We are a global leader in the production of innovative 
aluminum products and solutions and the world's largest recycler of aluminum. Our ambition is to be the leading provider of low-
carbon, sustainable aluminum solutions and to achieve a fully circular economy by partnering with our suppliers, as well as our 
customers in the aerospace, automotive, beverage can and specialties industries throughout North America, Europe, Asia and 
South America. Novelis had net sales of $17.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Novelis is a subsidiary of Hindalco Industries Limited, an 
industry leader in aluminum and copper, and the metals flagship company of the Aditya Birla Group, a multinational conglomerate 
based in Mumbai. For more information, visit www.novelis.com.
